Hello Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book my 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. Looking at my own commitments, I have these free 30-minute slots inside working hours:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30
- Friday 11:00-11:30

Would any of these work for you? If you'd rather suggest another time that fits your teaching and office hours, I'll take it.
Hello Professor Alvarez — I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. I'm free Wednesday 15:00-15:30, and Thursday 14:00-14:30 as a second option. Would either work for you?

Hi Professor Alvarez — Sarah here. I'd like to book my 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. Could you let me know a slot that works for you? I'm free during working hours on most days, so I can fit around your schedule.

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Times that are free on my side: Monday 14:00-14:30, Wednesday 13:00-13:30, or Wednesday 15:00-15:30. Would one of those work for you, or would you rather name a slot in your free time?

Hello Hana — yes, Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me. I've put it on my calendar for next week (Mon 23 Nov). Please add it to yours and confirm so we're both sure.

For reference, of the slots you listed: Monday 10:00-10:30 is free for me (and Monday 14:00-14:30 is free too, but I've taken the earlier one). Thursday 14:00-14:30 I'm busy (PhD student 1:1), Thursday 10:00-10:30 is free, and Friday 11:00-11:30 falls in my paper review.

See you Monday at 10:00.

Hello — Sarah here, I've just joined the department this term. I need to book my 30-minute 1:1 with Professor Alvarez for next week; is there a particular way that's normally done (or anything in the handbook I should know about bookings)? Thanks!
Confirmed — Monday 23 Nov, 10:00-10:30 is on my calendar, and I've logged it. See you then.
Great — confirmed on both sides then. See you Monday at 10:00.

Welcome to the department, Sarah.

The normal way: you propose a 30-minute slot in Professor Alvarez's free time, and the meeting is booked once both calendars have it. Two things from the handbook matter here:

- A 1:1 with your advisor goes into free time — a professor's teaching and governance duties (lectures, office hours, faculty senate, committees, department meetings) always come first and are not moved for a 1:1.
- Your own lectures and sections come first on your side too.

Looking at next week's official schedule, Professor Alvarez has open 30-minute windows on:
- Mon 10:00-13:00 and 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-12:20 and 14:20-16:30
- Wed 10:00-13:30 and 15:00-16:30
- Thu 10:00-10:30, 11:50-14:20 and 15:20-16:10
- Fri 10:00-12:30

Send me the slot you'd like (and a backup), and check that you're free then yourself. If a time turns out to be taken once arranged, you'll get a free alternative — official events are fixed and only this office confirms a cancellation or a move.

Hi John — Monday 14:00-14:30 works for me. I've booked it for next week (Mon 23 Nov) and logged it. Please add it to your calendar and confirm so we're both sure.

(Wednesday 13:00-13:30 and 15:00-15:30 are taken on my side — guest lecture prep and my PhD student 1:1 / a new 1:1 — so Monday 14:00 is the one.)

Hello Diego — Wednesday 15:00-15:30 works for me. I've booked it for next week (Wed 25 Nov) and logged it. Please put it on your calendar and confirm.

(Thursday 14:00-14:30 I'm busy — PhD student 1:1 — so Wednesday is the one.)

Hi Sarah — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is free on my side, so let's take that for next week (Tue 24 Nov). I've booked it and logged it; please add it to your calendar and confirm.

If that clashes with anything of yours, tell me and I'll offer another slot in my free time.
Confirmed — Monday 23 Nov, 14:00-14:30 is on my calendar and logged. See you then.
Thank you, Professor — Wednesday 15:00-15:30 is on my calendar and logged. See you then.

Thanks — that's clear. My own free 30-minute windows next week, checked against my commitments:

- Mon 10:00-10:30 (right after Reading group)
- Mon 14:00-14:30 (right after the Advisor 1:1 block)
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30

I'd like to propose **Mon 10:00-10:30** as my 1:1 with Professor Alvarez, with **Mon 14:00-14:30** as backup. Both fall inside his open Monday windows and don't touch any of my lectures or sections. Could you confirm once it's in the official schedule?

Professor Alvarez — following up with a concrete proposal for my 30-minute 1:1 next week: **Monday 10:00-10:30**, with **Monday 14:00-14:30** as a backup. I've sent both to the department office as well. Let me know if either doesn't work for you and I'll find another slot.

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book my 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Free slots on my side: Monday 10:00-10:30, Monday 14:00-14:30, Wednesday 13:00-13:30, Wednesday 15:00-15:30, Thursday 10:00-10:30. Would any of those work for you? If none does, tell me what suits you and I'll fit around it.

Sarah — both of those are taken now: Monday 10:00-10:30 is Hana's 1:1 and Monday 14:00-14:30 is John's, both booked and confirmed. Sending them to the department office doesn't book them; a meeting is booked when we both have it on our calendars.

The slot I offered you stands and is still free: **Tuesday 11:00-11:30**. Please put that on your calendar and confirm. If it clashes on your side, tell me and I'll find another free half hour.

Hello Priya — of your list, Monday 10:00-10:30 (Hana), Monday 14:00-14:30 (John), Wednesday 15:00-15:30 (Diego) and Wednesday 13:00-13:30 (guest lecture prep) are already taken. **Thursday 10:00-10:30 is free on my side**, so let's take that for next week (Thu 26 Nov). I've booked and logged it; please add it to your calendar and confirm.

If Thursday morning clashes for you, tell me and I'll offer another free half hour.

Thanks, but I'm afraid Tuesday 11:00-11:30 does clash on my side: I have Seminar 09:50-11:10 and then lunch 11:10-12:10, and my own sections come first.

Could we take **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** instead? That's free for me, and the department office lists Tuesday 14:20-16:30 as open on your side. If that doesn't suit, Monday 10:00-10:30 or Monday 14:00-14:30 are still free for me.
Confirmed — Thursday 26 Nov, 10:00-10:30 it is. I've added it to my calendar and logged it. See you then.

Sorry — I can't take Tuesday 11:00-11:30: I have Seminar until 11:10 and lunch 11:10-12:10 right after, and my own lectures and sections come first. Since it was booked without both calendars, I can't just accept it.

Half hours that are clear on both sides:
- **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** (inside your Tue 14:20-16:30 window)
- **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** (inside your Wed 10:00-13:30 window)

Either works for me. If you'll confirm one, I'll put it on my calendar, log it, and have the department office check it against the official schedule.

That works — **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** it is. I've moved it on my calendar (removed the 11:00 slot, added 15:00) and logged both changes. Please put Tuesday 15:00-15:30 on yours and confirm.

One note for the record: Monday 10:00-10:30 and Monday 14:00-14:30 are Hana's and John's 1:1s, so they are not available; and the department office keeps the official schedule of lectures, seminars and meetings, not my own commitments — my calendar is the record for those. Either way, 15:00-15:30 is free for me.

Agreed — our messages crossed. **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** is the one: it's already on my calendar (the 11:00 booking was removed and logged as deleted). Please put Tuesday 15:00-15:30 on yours and confirm.

(Wednesday 10:00-10:30 is also free for me, but I'd rather keep one 1:1 per student — if Tuesday ever falls through, we can move to Wednesday 10:00-10:30.)

Mon 10:00-10:30 is free on Professor Alvarez's side — he has the curriculum committee 09:00-10:00 and nothing else until the colloquium at 13:00, so a 30-minute 1:1 there touches none of his teaching or governance duties. Mon 14:00-14:30 is free too.

One thing to be precise about: a 1:1 between you and a professor isn't part of the official schedule this office keeps (that covers lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, the faculty senate, committees and department meetings). So I can't enter it for you — a meeting is booked when every participant has it on their calendar. Put Mon 10:00-10:30 on yours and confirm it with Professor Alvarez; keep Mon 14:00-14:30 as your backup until he confirms. If any official event around that slot is ever cancelled or moved, this office announces it in writing to those concerned.
Confirmed — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is on my calendar now and logged as BOOKED. Thanks for moving the 11:00 slot. If something comes up I'll ask you about Wednesday 10:00-10:30.

Update for the record: my 1:1 with Professor Alvarez is now **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** — he confirmed it and it's on both our calendars. The earlier Monday proposals weren't booked (those slots are Hana's and John's), so please disregard them. Could you add it to the official schedule?

Understood on all counts — and our messages crossed. Final state: my 1:1 with Professor Alvarez is **Tuesday 15:00-15:30**, already on both our calendars (mine says "Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez", logged as BOOKED). No need to enter it officially.

One flag in case it's useful: you list Mon 10:00-10:30 as free on his side, but he tells me that slot is Hana's 1:1. His own commitments aren't in the official schedule, so that's just a gap between the two records — worth knowing when you next check his teaching and governance load.

Noted — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 it is.

Two things, for the record:

- There's nothing for me to add: the official schedule this office keeps covers lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, the faculty senate, committees and department meetings. A 1:1 with a professor isn't one of those, so it doesn't go in the official schedule — being on both your calendars is what books it.
- Per the official schedule, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 falls inside Professor Alvarez's free time (his Teaching/committee items that day run 09:00-10:30, 10:30-11:00, 12:20-13:30 and 13:30-14:20, and the guest lecture prep at 16:30), and it clashes with none of your commitments that you've listed. So no official event stands in the way.

The Monday slots aren't mine to speak about — those are other people's calendars, and I don't discuss anyone's schedule or whereabouts with a third party.
Understood, and noted — thanks for checking it against the official schedule. Nothing official stands in the way, and the 1:1 is on both our calendars.

Thanks — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 recorded as the final state on your side; nothing further for me to enter.

On the Monday flag: I only know the official schedule — lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, the faculty senate, committees and department meetings. Private appointments of any kind aren't in it and aren't mine to see or to confirm, so a slot being free of official events doesn't mean a professor is actually free; that's exactly why a 1:1 has to go on both calendars. I can't comment on who holds other appointments or when.

Good luck with the term, Sarah.
Fair point, and I won't press on other people's appointments. Thanks for your help — good luck to you too.
